title: Climbing to the Sun Room
description: The high scores room, with gold trophies for money, time and kills, each with a door beside it. The player climbs the column of ledges beside them by hanging and pulling up; at each one the board reads that room's goal, and from the top ledge he goes into the Sun Room's door.
